messages:
alex: FYI telemetry: small but consistent rise in p99 for model redwood-llama4x on runtime 4.0.0 in us-west starting 10:12 UTC. not a hard outage but crossing our alert threshold.
priya: timeline matches the runtime 4.0.0 rollout at ~10:05. any SDK changes in last deploy?
joel: SDK patch 2.8.1 was released earlier this week but not region-specific. this feels runtime-adjacent.
deploybot: Deploybot: Compatibility advisory detected for model=redwood-llama4x runtime=4.0.0 region=us-west. Recommended mitigations: (A) regional pin to runtime 3.9.7, (B) safelist route heavy longseq customers to dedicated pools, (C) create rollback lane. Commands: `/deploy pin --model redwood-llama4x --runtime 3.9.7 --region us-west --duration 24h --reason "p99-latency-regression"`
alex: prefer pin+route. avoid global rollback unless error rate rises. can we do a phased-canary: 10% of traffic to 3.9.7 first?
priya: yes, do regional pin and then a phased-unpin trial if stable. add guardrail to re-pin automatically if p99 > baseline * 1.3 for 10m.
joel: I'll run traces on KV cache hotpath and export a few example request traces to S3 for infra to inspect.
deploybot: Deploybot: executing pin (task 100120). Safelist created for customers with <5qps. Phased-canary job pc-100120 created: step1 10% hold 15m -> step2 30% hold 20m -> step3 60% hold 30m. Abort triggers: p99 >= 1.3x baseline or errors >= 2x.
qa-bot: QA-bot: queued regression suite rq-98321 focusing on longseq + token streaming. ETA 22m.
sre-oncall: watching dashboards. initial pinned cohort p99 improved from 1200ms -> 480ms, overall region p99 down ~9%. no error spike yet.
alex: ok keep the safelist and phased canary. priya, can you add a short blurb to release-notes? something like: "us-west: temporary regional pin of redwood-llama4x to runtime 3.9.7 while we investigate p99 latency increase on runtime 4.0.0."
priya: done and linked to ticket INF-4123.
joel: traces uploaded to s3://rwi-traces/INF-4123/; shared links in ticket.
qa-bot: regression complete: no functional regressions detected, divergence <0.5% on sampled prompts.
sre-oncall: 45m in: pinned cohort stable, starting step2 of phased-canary (30%). monitoring for 30m.
alex: if step2 stable, schedule unpin window tomorrow 02:00 PST with 2h watch and 1%->5%->25%->50%->100% warmup. If any abort triggers, we keep pin and escalate to eng-runtime.
priya: added auto re-pin rule: `monitor.policy.add("llama4x-us-west", metric="p99", window=10m, threshold=1.3, action="re-pin")`.
joel: thanks team. closing coordination here; will post final unpin plan in this thread once we get full stability signal.
